title: Page bundle
description: The files a web page ships, and the facts read from them without running them: stack, routes, source modules, keys, storage, design tokens, motion, fonts, and assets.

source.description: The page URL or folder the caller passed.

dir.description: Folder that holds the files. For fetch, a folder in the data home. For parse, the folder the caller passed.

files.description: Every file read, page first, in the order found.

url.description: Where fetch got the file. Null for parse.

meta.description: The page title and each <meta> name or property with its content.

stack.description: Each library or service whose signature matched, in the order of the signature table.

evidence.description: The text that matched, and the file it matched in.

modules.description: Source files named in the bundle or its source maps, sorted by path. names holds the function or message names a string tags with path#name.

routes.description: String literals that look like app paths, such as /settings. Candidates, sorted.

keys.description: Keys a keyboard handler compares against, from case labels and .key or .code comparisons in scripts that listen for keydown or keyup. Candidates, sorted.

storageKeys.description: Keys passed to localStorage or sessionStorage, sorted.

tokens.description: CSS custom properties by the selector that declares them, for :root, :host, html, and theme selectors. A rule inside @media, @supports, or @container is keyed by those conditions and the selector, such as "@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) :root".

fonts.description: Font families from @font-face rules and Google Fonts links, sorted.

assets.description: Image, font, audio, and video URLs the files reference, sorted. Absolute for fetch, as written for parse.

cacheHit.description: Always false. A page is read fresh on every call.
